import "strings"
import "timezone"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "run" or r["_field"] == "trip")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "cwp1" or r.deviceId == "cwp2" or r.deviceId == "cwp3" or r.deviceId == "chwp1" or r.deviceId == "chwp2" or r.deviceId == "chwp3")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with state: if r.trip == 1.0 then 2.0 else r.run,
    deviceId: strings.toUpper(v: r.deviceId)
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "deviceId", "state"])

import "math"

durationInMinutes = float(v: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / 60000000000.0

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwp1" or r["deviceId"] == "chwp2" or r["deviceId"] == "chwp3")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "speedFb")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
    cat: math.floor(x: r._value / 5.0) * 5.0,
    _value: 1.0,
  }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
    category: if r.cat == 0.0 then "OFF" else string(v: r.cat) + " - " + string(v: r.cat + 5.0) + " Hz",
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["category", "deviceId"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with _value: float(v: r._value) / durationInMinutes
  }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["deviceId"], columnKey: ["category"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

import "strings"
import "timezone"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

devices = ["chwp1","chwp2","chwp3","cwp1","cwp2","cwp3"]
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "run" or r["_field"] == "trip")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(set: devices, value: r.deviceId))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with state: if r.trip == 1.0 then 2.0 else r.run,
    deviceId: strings.toUpper(v: r.deviceId)
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "deviceId", "state"])

bucket = "cpms"

    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
    |> group(columns: ["_time"])
    |> mean()
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "CHWP Avg Speed")

chwDeltaT =

    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flow")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "chwHeader")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "deltaT")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "CHW ΔT")

cwpSpeed =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "speedFb")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.deviceId, set: cwpIds))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
